questions.1: Q How often do you eat flour-based foods?

overview.title: Obesity/Body Fat
overview.info: Obesity refers to a state of abnormally excessive body fat, divided into secondary obesity (caused by disease, genetics, medication, etc.) and primary obesity (caused by lifestyle), with primary obesity accounting for more than 90%. It can cause various health problems such as type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia, so prevention and improvement through diet, exercise, and behavioral control are necessary.
